row: Portable one-home placement, interval checkpoints, slow failover and server-side effect fencing

homeModel.working: one encrypted, mounted, writable home bound to owner/agent/computer/disk
homeModel.recovery: sealed generations are immutable; the one platform placement record carries selectedGeneration and changes by placementRevision
homeModel.migration: one import key has one terminal generation; replay returns already_imported and never imports twice
homeModel.generationLineage: v1.x agent.commit generations and v2 sealed checkpoints are the same monotonic generation lineage; existing state is imported once, never renumbered into a parallel lineage

signing.admission: same pinned-key, commandId/nonce replay, owner/agent/computer binding and expiry rules as device-service/3

base.rule: additive portable-placement minor; every v2 fixture remains byte-identical

placementAuthority.authorityLease: short executor term under home epoch
placementAuthority.revisionRule: checkpoints advance placementRevision and selectedGeneration; only authority-changing move commits advance homeEpoch
placementAuthority.activeMoveRule: a committed move is immutable history; placement.activeMove clears on commit, and a later epoch/revision may start a new move
placementAuthority.legacyReconciliation: the v2 placement record and import-once generation lineage remain canonical; this minor widens location and executor authentication
placementAuthority.messageAuthority: home.placement.update and home.mount.request remain cloud-controller-only; home.placement.record is the widened platform-owned portable authority

checkpointPolicy.pathRule: NFC Unicode relative paths with spaces are allowed; exact credential, key, browser-profile, database/sidecar and excluded-tree patterns are skipped before manifest construction
checkpointPolicy.skippedCaptureRule: capture records only category, reasonCode, count and pathSha256 for excluded paths; a manifest that lists an excluded path is invalid
checkpointPolicy.consistency: quiesce writers, SQLite backup, stable-file staging, upload verification, then current-epoch CAS

failoverPolicy.unreachableBasis: no recent platform-timestamped authenticated agent-service readiness covering home, runtime and Matrix intake
failoverPolicy.wakeRule: asleep_wakeable triggers one wake attempt bound to the current unreachableSincePlatform episode and an eligibility-sweep grace period before takeover

executorAuthentication.cloud: cloud_workload is admitted only on a cloud-held placement with the platform-pinned workload key

mac.binding: the active pinned key is bound to exactly one deviceServiceId and keyEpoch
mac.admission: signerKeyId must equal the active pinned key; the signature must verify; meta.deviceServiceId must equal placement.location.deviceServiceId
mac.rotation: the previous active pinned key signs the bounded rotation frame; previousKeyId equals signerKeyId; nextKeyEpoch increments exactly once; nextKeyId differs; the prior key is retired atomically
mac.expiry: every executor frame has expiresAt after issuedAt, at most two hours later, and is refused unless nowPlatform is before expiresAt
mac.renewal: every renewal issues a new leaseId; the presented expiry must exactly match the platform-trusted expiry

executorAuthentication.wakingRule: a waking home is quarantined until it reads placement and reacquires current authority

matrixPublication.serialization: publication admission and send are serialized against move commit

eraseSemantics.receiptCoverage: complete and pending_offline receipts report every requested location as erased or pending; complete coveredLocations equals the reported location set
eraseSemantics.restore: a tombstone refuses every operation and restore for its homeId regardless of a declared epoch; re-creating an agent allocates a new homeId; browser sessions excluded
